WHAT THIS PAGE IS — THE SMALL PRINT, AT FULL SIZE

This page is the site edition of THE DJINN, seeded at RECORDED time from the engine of record (djinn_mind/engine.py) — the same holdings, the same adjudication, running in your browser. The page carries the mind and the holdings index; the corpus text itself is not embedded in this page — memory is the admitted record, not a blob inside a page. The text lives in the record, sharded under djinn/corpus/ on this site, and when an answer needs a record's full text the page fetches that shard and verifies the text's SHA-256 against the index before speaking it. The shards travel compressed — gzip, carried as base64 text, inflated by the browser's own native decompression — and the SHA-256 verification runs over the decompressed text, exactly as it did over the plain text. The named trade: this page is no longer one self-contained, fully-offline file — corpus answers need the shards reachable (same site, behind the same Pass); canon, live-state, and doctrine answers are carried whole on the page and work regardless. The engine on the house machine additionally records every interaction in its own hash-chained ledger and appends wishes to the daemon's ledger; this page cannot write either ledger — interactions here are not recorded in the engine's chain, and wishes here queue locally only (above). Live figures are a stamped snapshot, not a stream: the page is regenerated and re-pushed every 30 minutes, and each figure names its read time. There is no guardrail layer in this mind — what it will not answer, it will not answer because the record does not hold it or because Taylor said so in his words in the register; every refusal here is an UNHELD with its gathering path named. Holdings at this read: canon 25 claims (E-01–E-22 + S-01–S-03) with 6 drop certificates computed live · corpus 5681 admitted entries across 13 packs (ai_safety 6, codec_c2 15, grok_bots 8, maritime 7, metadata_only 2182, my_drive 3413, name_only 19, raw_ingest_2026 5, record 10, root 3, space 3, spatial_vr 4, te_assurance 6) · eight ledger readers stamped above · the corpus text is held in the record, not in this page: 100 text shards + 15 scoring-profile shards under djinn/corpus/, carried gzip-compressed as base64 text and inflated in the browser, fetched on demand.
